title: Application of Merchant Refunds to Pocketwire Pay in 4 Plans
content:
A merchant refund on a purchase split with Pocketwire Pay in 4 reduces the plan behind that purchase according to the tier's refund order, which on every tier is the last installments first, and a refund larger than what is still owed on the plan is returned to the customer's payment source.

| Tier | Order in which a merchant refund reduces a plan |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter | Last installments first |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic | Last installments first |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select | Last installments first |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Preferred | Last installments first |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Premier | Last installments first |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Elite | Last installments first |

### How the refund is applied

- The refund is set against the plan's unpaid installments starting from the last one and moving towards the earlier ones, each installment being reduced to nothing before the one before it is touched.
- Where the refund is larger than what is still owed on the plan, the plan is reduced by what it still owes and the part of the refund beyond that is returned to the customer's payment source.
- Each merchant refund is recorded against the plan with the date it posted and the amount by which the plan is reduced, and that amount comes off what the customer owes on Pocketwire Pay in 4.

### Worked examples (hypothetical plan of USD 200.00, four installments of USD 50.00, installments 1 and 2 paid, USD 100.00 still owed)

**Refund of USD 60.00.** Installment 4 is reduced from USD 50.00 to USD 0.00, and the remaining USD 10.00 reduces installment 3 from USD 50.00 to USD 40.00. The plan now owes USD 40.00.

**Refund of USD 30.00.** Installment 4 is reduced from USD 50.00 to USD 20.00; installment 3 is untouched at USD 50.00.

**Refund of USD 130.00.** The refund exceeds the USD 100.00 still owed. Installments 3 and 4 are reduced to nothing, the plan is reduced by USD 100.00, and USD 30.00 is returned to the customer's payment source.

### Basis Q&A

**Does a partial refund lower the next installment due?**
Not first. The refund reduces the last installments first, so the next installment keeps its amount unless the refund is large enough to reach it.

**Where does money beyond what the plan owes go?**
To the customer's payment source.
